title: Map — In Buildprint, what does a stale branch error mean

messages.content:
In Buildprint, what does a stale branch error mean and can Build mode edit database records?

(Answering inside the brain-map view: mention the exact repo-relative paths of every relevant file so the map can highlight them.)

Both answers are grounded in the scraped manual.

**Stale branch error** — Bubble has changed since Buildprint's last sync of that branch. Buildprint agents work from point-in-time snapshots, so any edit you (or another agent) made directly in the Bubble editor isn't visible until re-synced. Fix: ask the agent to sync the branch and resolve conflicts if prompted. A stale branch is also one of the listed causes of a "cannot apply changes" failure.
- `brain/buildprint/troubleshooting-faqs.md:17-18` (stale branch), `:20-31` (as an apply-blocker)
- `brain/buildprint/permissions-and-data-safety.md:114-120` (snapshots / why staleness happens)

**Can Build mode edit database records?** — No. Build mode edits app *structure* only (pages, reusable elements, workflows, data types, option sets, styles, settings, supported API Connector config). It **cannot edit Bubble database Things**. All Buildprint database tools are read-only — agents can search/fetch/aggregate records but never create, modify, or delete them. Caution: that database read access **bypasses your Bubble privacy rules** (it uses editor access), so treat any returned records as sensitive.
- `brain/buildprint/permissions-and-data-safety.md:64` (Build mode cannot edit Things), `:101-106` (read-only DB tools + privacy-rule bypass)

Routing map: `brain/buildprint/INDEX.md`. Project-specific Buildprint rules (dev-branch-only, Plan-mode-first) that override generic advice: `decisions.md` 2026-05-01, summarized in `CLAUDE.md`.
